name: Virgin 2 Hana Hiraku Shoujo-tachi no AVG
original_name: ヴァージン＾２ 花ひらく少女たちのＡＶＧ
source:
Koji is caught at peeping after the tennis girls, so school girls committee stripped him and ridiculed his masculinity. In order to defend his pride school nurse advises him to be proactive with girls and prove his case.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-september-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
浩二因偷窥网球部女生而被当场抓获，学校的女生委员会扒光他的衣服，还嘲笑他缺乏男子气概。为了捍卫尊严，保健老师建议他主动接近女孩，用行动证明自己。
